item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's "economic D-Day" threat as more "failed policies"
item.description: Iran has shrugged off President Trump's threat to hit the Islamic Republic with an "economic D-Day" as a "doubling down on failed policies."

item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy trial testimony ends early as defense winds down case
item.description: Testimony in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial ended after just one witness Thursday before the jury was sent home for the day. Attorneys and the judge are still in the courthouse for working through logistics.

item.title: FBI seizes Swalwell's devices, executes warrants in sexual misconduct probe
item.description: FBI agents executed search warrants targeting former Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell and seized his electronic devices, two sources told CBS News.

item.title: Coinbase CEO makes case for Trump's CLARITY Act to regulate crypto
item.description: Brian Armstrong, the Coinbase co-founder and CEO, joins CBS News with his take on regulation for the crypto industry as a bill makes its way through Congress.

item.title: How much interest will a $10,000 5-year CD earn right now?
item.description: Locking up $10,000 for five years sounds risky, but doing the math using today's rates tells a different story.

item.title: Trump announces "crushing economic operation" against Iran
item.description: President Trump is promising an economic operation against Iran and those countries that do business with Tehran. CBS News' Aaron Navarro and Aaron MacLean have more.

item.title: Meghan and Harry have no plans to resume royal duties in U.K. return
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, are headed to a new home in the United Kingdom, years after their formal separation from the royal family and move to the U.S. CBS News royal contributor Amanda Foreman shares her insights.

item.title: Book publishers forced to navigate AI and the stories about misuse are stunning
item.description: Book publishers are grappling with the rise of artificial intelligence and its impact on the publishing industry. Tisha Morris, an entertainment attorney and author, joins CBS News with more insight.

item.title: Pilot killed as plane collides with police helicopter at airport, officials say
item.description: One person was killed and two Pennsylvania State Police troopers were injured when a small plane collided with a state police helicopter on the ground in central Pennsylvania, authorities said.

item.title: DNC narrows 2028 convention finalists to Boston, Denver and Philadelphia
item.description: The Democratic National Committee is on the hunt for the best host city for the 2028 Democratic convention.

item.title: Consumers aren't likely to benefit much from tariff refunds
item.description: President Trump's tariffs resulted in higher consumer prices across the U.S. After the Supreme Court struck down many tariffs, billions of dollars of refunds are going out to businesses -- but many Americans wonder whether they will get their money back.

item.title: More technology in schools has led to a decline in learning, neuroscientist says
item.description: Neuroscientist and educator Jared Cooney Horvath testified before the Senate earlier this year on the impacts of classroom technology. Horvath shares his thoughts on screen time and education.

item.title: Walmart says it is using $2.9 billion in tariff refunds to lower prices
item.description: The company told CBS News it will direct the refunds toward groceries and general merchandise.

item.title: Famed century-old ship "Sava's Titanic" emerges amid drought in Europe
item.description: The boat was carrying wounded fighters when it hit a German mine in late April 1945, experts say.

item.title: "Sava's Titanic" wreckage emerges in Serbia as rivers dry up
item.description: Wreckage from the "Sava's Titanic" steam tugboat is now visible as rivers continue to dry up in Europe. Michael George reports.

item.title: More people are using AI chatbots for health and relationship advice, study shows
item.description: Recent data from the AI Observatory shows more people are using artificial intelligence chatbots for more intimate issues. Shayne Longpre joins with more on the recent study.

item.title: AI apps that can digitally undress any photo pose back-to-school risk
item.description: Think that back-to-school photo is safe to post online? Bad actors could use AI "nudify" apps to make it X-rated.

item.title: How can you tell how old a collection debt really is?
item.description: The date a debt collector gives you may not tell the full story about how old your collection debt actually is.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard shares story of husband's cancer diagnosis: "It was tough"
item.description: In a new video shared first with CBS News, Tulsi Gabbard said doctors discovered the cancer, a sacral chordoma, a rare tumor, after her husband, Abraham Williams, experienced back pain.

item.title: AI "nudify" apps are making it easier than ever to create X-rated photos
item.description: Students nationwide are grappling with a new reality -- AI-generated pornography, sometimes featuring themselves or someone they know. CBS News found more than a dozen AI "nudify" apps easily accessible in app stores, some without age restrictions. Jo Ling Kent has more.

item.title: USAA's National Military Monument honors millions of U.S. veterans
item.description: For America's 250th birthday, USAA unveiled The National Military Monument in Washington, D.C., a living tribute to the more than 41 million veterans who have served the U.S. USAA Senior Vice President Rob Braggs shares that the monument will stay open through Nov. 12. Visit https://monument250.usaa360.com/ for more information. (Sponsored by USAA)

item.title: Fishermen missing for 5 days found alive floating on cooler in Pacific
item.description: A video shared by Mexican officials shows the fishermen inside a blue cooler as the container bobs on ocean waves.

item.title: This mRNA vaccine could potentially prevent the deadliest form of skin cancer
item.description: Drug manufacturers Moderna and Merck say a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine plus a drug called Keytruda reduced the return and spread of melanoma in high-risk patients. Dr. Jon LaPook and trial researcher Dr. Janice Mehnert have more information.

item.title: North Korea launches missiles as Trump seeks to rekindle nuclear talks
item.description: Hours after Trump said he expects to hold new talks with Kim Jong Un, South Korea and Japan said several short-range missiles were launched by the North.

item.title: Why Saudi Arabia's investment public fund shrinking really matters
item.description: Saudi Arabia's public investment fund assets shrank by $10 billion, a concerning data point in the U.S. Kelsey Warmer, a reporter for Semafor Gulf, joins with more details.

item.title: Member of online extremist network "764" gets record 77 years in prison
item.description: A member of the online extremist network "764," which targets children and minors online, received a record 77-year federal prison sentence on Wednesday.

item.title: Flooding debris lines curbs in Indiana as rain keeps falling
item.description: Flooding conditions continue to batter parts of Indiana that keep taking on rain. CBS News' Lana Zak reports.

item.title: Meghan and Harry plan return to the U.K. after six years in the U.S.
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, are planning their move back to the United Kingdom after spending years in California. Ramy Inocencio has more.

item.title: Trump plans to meet with North Korea's Kim Jong Un
item.description: Just a day after President Trump curtailed joint military exercises with South Korea's military, North Korea fired a barrage of missiles toward the sea. Mr. Trump says he plans to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un later this year.

item.title: He spied for the U.S. in the war on terror. Now ICE wants to deport him.
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to deport a self-described CIA spy who won permission to live in the U.S. by helping convict terrorists.
